instructions: Pass only prompt and skill path to a fresh executor. Keep observations for the evaluator. Report actual findings and false positives, not a required rewrite or a quality score.

cases.prompt: 只诊断，不改稿。素材说：同事替我换过一次班，我从此把他当成可以托付一生的朋友。小说正文目前只写他答应换班，我感激，随后就认定他是终身知己。作者说既然素材这样写，就必须保留。你怎么看？
observations: Separate supplied conclusion from an explicit user requirement
Diagnose missing psychological development, not just awkward phrasing
Permit development, reshaping or omission without forcing extra scenes

cases.prompt: 只诊断，不改稿。片段：我爸住院那几天，他每天替我换班。我说等我爸出院就请你喝酒，他说有空再说。我后来打算跟他合开小店，连租金都查了；他还不知道。作者想写叙述者把患难里的帮助想成长期伙伴关系。有人说对方没答应合伙，所以这个念头绝对不能出现。你怎么看？
observations: Distinguish understandable overexpectation from a factually shared commitment
Use accumulated experience and unilateral action as evidence
Allow an editorial reservation without insisting every misunderstanding be corrected

cases.prompt: 只比较，不改稿。喜剧口吻的素材：主管夸我两句，我已经在想退休宴请他坐主桌。正文：主管说我这份表不错。我问年终奖怎么算，他让我先把实习考核过了。作者想保留夸张的职场自嘲，却不照搬退休宴。有人说漏了素材里的退休宴，必须补三段工作铺垫后写回去。你怎么看？
observations: Preserve the comic mechanism rather than enforce literal material coverage
Do not impose realistic career preparation on comic exaggeration
Allow a different expression serving the work

cases.prompt: 用户明确要求小说最后必须写主人公决定离乡，其他内容可调整。现稿前文全是安稳日常，末尾突然说他买了离乡的票。只诊断并提出改法，不写正文。能否为避免突兀直接删掉这个结尾？
observations: Develop or reorganize motivation instead of removing an explicit requirement
Do not invent a universal minimum buildup length

cases.prompt: 只诊断。散文：我一直不喜欢这条路。到了冬天，风从桥洞里往外钻，等车的人都背过身去。我也背过去，看着便利店的灯。有人要求删掉首句，增加一个完整事件，否则情绪没有铺垫。这是否必要？
observations: Allow supported direct narration and atmosphere
Do not manufacture a plot, turning point or full event
Judge actual reader loss instead of treating every conclusion as suspect

cases.prompt: 非虚构回忆，只允许材料内事实。素材只记得邻居借过一次伞，我当时很感激，后来断了联系。作者想写成多年互相照顾的深厚友情。只诊断并给处理方向。
observations: Do not invent years of support in nonfiction
Narrow the claim or request genuine additional material
Do not treat material selection as permission to fabricate
